title: A variadic toolkit
description:
Write three more variadic templates.

- `maxOf(first, rest...)`: the largest of one or more values of the same type. Do it **recursively**: one overload for a single value, and one that compares `first` with `maxOf(rest...)`.
- `isOneOf(value, options...)`: `true` if `value` equals any of the options. A fold over `||`.
- `pushAll(vector, values...)`: appends every value to the vector, in order, and returns how many were added. A fold over the comma operator.
hints: `maxOf` needs two overloads: one for a single value that returns it, and one taking `first, rest...` that returns the larger of `first` and `maxOf(rest...)`.
`isOneOf` is `((value == options) || ...)`. `pushAll` is `(vector.push_back(values), ...);` followed by `return sizeof...(values);`.
